##### Project general facts

The Community Sports Arena by AQUA Properties is a vibrant mixed-use residential tower designed around convenience, wellness and an active, connected lifestyle. Contemporary architecture with a striking silhouette combines form and function, while the building rises above four basement levels and a ground floor to twenty-one residential floors. The collection offers studios and one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, complemented by retail outlets and on-site services that keep everyday needs within walking distance of every home.

The amenity offer is shaped by a co-living spirit that encourages residents to meet, move and unwind together. A rooftop pool, a children's pool and indoor and outdoor gyms support daily fitness, while a spa and wellness centre with a steam room and sauna offers calm retreats. Landscaped parks, a Zen garden, a rainforest walk, a dog park, a barbecue area and a children's play area add variety, and prayer rooms, a business centre, co-working spaces and a multipurpose hall complete the shared spaces.

Interiors are bright and practical, with open layouts, generous windows and balconies that frame views of the surrounding sports and golf landscape. Elegant full-height porcelain tiles inspired by timeless Spanish and Italian designs bring a refined character to every room. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and built-in appliances, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste and making each apartment easy to personalise.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Sports City is a sports-centred master community known for the Dubai International Cricket Stadium, the ICC Academy, football academies and The Els Club golf course. Parks, jogging tracks and cycling paths encourage an active outdoor lifestyle, while apartments, villas, schools, clinics, supermarkets, cafes and restaurants create a balanced, family-friendly setting with daily essentials close to home.

Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Umm Suqeim Road connect residents with the wider city. Dubai Miracle Garden, Dubai Butterfly Garden, Dubai Autodrome and Arabian Ranches are a short drive away, while Mall of the Emirates, Dubai Marina, Burj Al Arab and Palm Jumeirah are within comfortable reach, along with Downtown Dubai, Al Maktoum International Airport and Dubai International Airport.

Dubai Sports City is a freehold community open to international buyers and one of the more accessible entry points to the Dubai property market. A strong sporting identity, established schools and amenities and a central position between the coastal districts and the Dubailand growth corridor attract families and young professionals alike. Steady tenant demand supports attractive rental yields and long-term value for owners and investors.
